name: Crowns
description: Place one crown in every row, column and region. Crowns never touch.
hint: Click: × then crown · drag to lay × · arrows + Space · ⌘Z undo

howTo.goal: Place one crown in every row, every column and every coloured region.
rules: Crowns never touch, not even diagonally.
Mark cells that can't hold a crown with ×; it's only a note.
Every puzzle has exactly one answer. The daily gets harder through the week.
